title: Tokens, tokenisation and why cost is measured that way

videos.script: A model does not read words. It reads numbers, and each number stands for a piece of text. {{ids}} Those pieces are called tokens. A short common word is usually one. A rare word is two or three. {{pieces}} Every price list, every limit and every counter on a model is in tokens, not in words or characters. {{units}} So the same message costs a different amount depending on the language it is written in. {{language}} In this lesson you cut real sentences into tokens, in English and in Portuguese, with the tokenizer production systems use. {{tok}} You count a file, and work out what a request would cost from prices you choose yourself. {{cost}} And you see why a model that writes fluent paragraphs can still miscount the letters in a word. It never saw the letters. {{letters}}
